context:
Goal: a red batch is dropped and fixed at once, so main merges sooner.
Problem (goal): a batch run with one red job stays open until its slowest jobs end, and no one is woken; batch 104 went red at 11:55 CST while the macOS and Windows jobs ran on.
Based on (ruling): R4, your 14:56 CST Nov 10 words "yes D is approved": batch CI runs lint first and cancels the rest when lint goes red.
Based on (measured): batch 104's run (GitHub Actions run 43270332555): the checks job failed at 11:55 CST, and two jobs were still running at 12:02 CST; batch runner 10 found it at 11:57 CST only by reading.
Departs from: R4, where only a red lint cancels the run — the run cancels on a red in any required job.
Meanwhile: the lint-only step from R4 goes ahead; nothing waits on this.

lastAnswer.note: ah ok C is good go for it (chat, 12:14 CST, relayed by the retrospective)

options.how: The first red required job cancels the rest; the run ends red and the red-run comment wakes the batch runner.
options.label: Any red job cancels the run
options.lose: About half of red runs hide a second bad lane, each costing an extra full run.

options.how: Keep R4 as it is: only a red lint cancels the run.
options.label: Lint only, as ruled
options.lose: A red outside lint still waits for the slowest job.

options.gain: Acts at the first red and still sees every bad lane in one run.
options.how: Each required job that fails posts the red-run notice as it fails, so the batch runner starts the drop and fix at once; the other jobs run on and name any second bad lane; the new head's run replaces the old one. R4's lint-first cancel stays.
options.label: Wake at first red, no cancel (Recommended)
options.lose: The old run's jobs use CI minutes until the new run replaces it.

reply: Closed with your 12:14 CST chat pick c: each failing required job wakes the batch runner as it fails, and the rest run on. Filed as step red-job-wakes-runner for a lane.
short: Any red job cancels the batch run?
title: Should the first red required job cancel the rest of a batch CI run, not only a red lint?
why: Batch 104 sat red for minutes with no wake.
